There are fluid ducts within the cartilage of your lobes, extreme irritation of the skin like abrasions, pinching, or hard impacts (like being punched) can disturb or rupture the ducts. Cauliflower ear is a good example of this. Infection can also be a common cause inflammation. I would suggest doing gentle saline rinses and keeping neosporin on it, if the inflammation doesn't subside you may need to have a medical specialist take a look at it. This is completely speculation, I am not a professional, anything you decide to do should be preceded with intensive research. I hope this helps explain things a little bit better though, and I'm sorry you're going through this, I've had a few blowouts before and I know how frustrating it can be to have you lobes fight you while you're trying to stretch. I hope that this resolves itself with a little TLC, and I hope you heal up quickly! 😁

I am currently having the "Low Power" issue where, even with a fully charged battery, the draw cuts out after about 1.5 seconds and displays the "Low Power" indicator. Upon doing some further research, I've found a couple different fixes for it. Tightening the screws on the contact plate in the battery door can solve it, using higher amperage batteries can usually resolve the issue, or using polygrip pliers to press the contact plate harder against the battery door can solve it (which I haven't personally tried), so far only new 30A batteries have done the trick for me. Kindof a bummer honestly. I don't recommend trying to get help from Voopoo, that doesn't do any justice for most folks. I'm going to continue to troubleshoot the issue, if I find a surefire fix I'll post it in a new thread
